notes: Zata is a Rwandan tax-compliance (EBM fiscal invoicing), inventory and ZataPay payments platform. The vendor publishes its full OpenAPI 3.1 contract at https://docs.zata.rw/openapi.json (the Fern docs site is rendered from it); it is committed verbatim as upstream.json and served unchanged apart from info.x-openfn-adaptor. It covers 106 operations in 19 groups: auth/user, access, company, branches, parties, products, reference data, transactions (sale/purchase/proforma/refund/calculate/download), expenses, tax reporting, dashboard, ZataPay (bearer) and ZataPay external (Zata-Pay-Auth header), credits, subscription, pharma patient/insurance, S3-compatible storage (SigV4) and a health check. The adaptor (@openfn/language-zata) is a thin get/post/put/request wrapper that joins configuration.apiVersion (default v1) onto configuration.baseUrl (default https://ebm.zata.rw/api), so production paths are https://ebm.zata.rw/api/v1/...; the spec declares only the sandbox server https://sandbox.zata.rw with the same /api/v1 paths. Every adaptor JSDoc example path (data/product-type, test, transaction/sale, company, product/reduce-quantity/{productId}) and all 26 operations of the previous hand-authored stub exist in the vendor spec. Schema names are Fern-generated (e.g. ApiV1CompanyGetResponsesContentApplicationJsonSchemaDataItems) and are kept verbatim, so data-schemas/ carries those names.
